# Babble Engine

> Babble Engine turns a line of text into gibberish speech for game characters: made-up language, critter chatter, robot beeps and soft tones. It runs in the browser, is free, and is made by Wrong Floor.

Babble Engine is for game developers who want characters to "talk" without voice acting. You type a line, pick a style and a voice, listen, and export a WAV file. You can also record your own voice in the studio and use it as the source for the babble. Recordings stay in the browser (IndexedDB); nothing is uploaded and there are no accounts.

## Use it

- [Babble Engine](https://babble.wrongfloor.studio/): the tool, in English and Dutch
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/wrongfloor-dev/babble-engine): plain HTML and JavaScript, no dependencies

## Styles

16 styles. Voice styles (work with your own recorded voice): Critter Chatter, Babblish, Bloopa Doopa, Name Talk, Grunts & Barks, Grumble, Gizmo, Sprite, Spooky Whisper, Echo Folk, Mumble Radio, Babytalk. Sound styles (no voice): Text Blips, Droid Chirps, Soft Tones, Talking Instruments (with a kazoo).
